thought: This is a classic Gen 9 OU Balance structure built around the Gliscor/Gholdengo/Great Tusk defensive core. Gliscor sets Spikes and provides long-term staying power with Poison Heal, Gholdengo blocks hazard removal and threatens special offense, and Great Tusk removes hazards while providing Ground/Fighting coverage. Kingambit serves as the primary win condition with Supreme Overlord and priority, Ogerpon-Wellspring acts as a powerful wallbreaker with Ivy Cudgel and Encore utility, and Dragapult provides speed control, status spreading, and revenge killing. The team has good type synergy, hazard control on both sides, and multiple paths to victory.
